name: @asciimoth/zpjs
description: Zig progress protocol client library for JavaScript and TypeScript
author: ASCIIMoth (https://github.com/asciimoth)

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.test:compat: npm run build && ZPJS_REQUIRE_ZPG=1 node --test tests/zpg.test.js
scripts.lint: biome check src tests scripts examples package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json biome.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.prepack: npm run check && npm run test:package
